limitations: Reference-only child publication following b3e667a9f2d4ff85bfe90c0af43d00497304aa3c; inspected production base is separately pinned above. No implementation, merge, deployment, release or consumer acceptance is claimed.

Current implementation guidance is integration/design.md. Original design.json and scope-revision/design.md, their full-text Works layouts and collection-body parity remain historical only. The original immutable reference at 1f0e02fa8b38f9e355297ad59247e17344b1b7ea remains available.

Root inventory is regenerated for the combined reference payload; the inherited exact-inventory verifier now applies to the complete final checkout. Earlier commit inventories remain exact only for their own commits.

Original production-layout/native/browser/guard checks remain attributed to .reference/checks.json and the original immutable record; new simplified native and offline-DOM evidence does not supersede those checks or qualify final runtime behavior.

Synthetic bibliographic metadata and modeled 5% churn; simplified occurrence/citation tuples and flat adapted corpus. No actual 50-release signed-source build, structured-subject end-to-end or stale metadata ingestion proof.
Query receipts contain observations as well as expected-count assertions. The design distinguishes those counts and excludes rejected Works comparisons from current acceptance.

Native timings omit browser/transfer and presentation. Offline DOM uses fetch/history doubles. Full production installed-browser/network/WASM, resource-budget and 50-edition history transport qualification remain explicit integration gates; no fresh claim is made for them.

General source/build and exact metadata/occurrence requirements remain; Riverhog release semantics/applicability stay producer-owned. Scope-specific numeric performance budgets are to be recorded by the integration agent before claiming qualification.
